newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down in thin trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans ended down in low volume trade Wednesday at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with the session haunted by the fall in Chicago prices, traders said.

Sellers have been spooked by recent volatility and stayed away. FAS elevator soybeans for delivery to Rosario lost $5 to $270. Maize prices were steady to firm in moderate volume, with demand from both exports and local consumers. FAS elevator maize was unchanged at $104 for Buenos Aires. FAS elevator sunflower seed lost $2 for Rosario to $220, following soybeans lower in slow trade.
